signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a two-story house with an attached two-car garage, though a large front-yard tree obscures much of the facade.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Neatly shaped shrubs, a mulched tree ring and an edged lawn are visible, but this is consistent with homeowner maintenance and shows no crew-level evidence.

signals.notes: The house has a well-kept frontage with a red front door, a white two-car garage and a sealed asphalt driveway, while a large tree in the front yard blocks most of the main facade and roof.
